import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_numbers = sc.nextInt();
        int max_k = sc.nextInt();

        double[] probabilities = new double[total_numbers];
        int[] index_map = new int[total_numbers];
        Arrays.fill(index_map, -1);
        int valid_count = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < total_numbers; i++) {
            probabilities[i] = sc.nextDouble();
            if (probabilities[i] > 1e-9) {
                index_map[i] = valid_count++;
            }
        }

        max_k = Math.min(max_k, valid_count);

        int size = 1 << valid_count;
        double[] D = new double[size];
        double[] sum_prob = new double[size];
        double[] Q = new double[valid_count];

        Arrays.fill(D, 0.0);
        Arrays.fill(sum_prob, 0.0);
        Arrays.fill(Q, 0.0);

        D[0] = 1.0;

        for (int mask = 1; mask < size; mask++) {
            int last_bit = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);
            int prev_mask = mask ^ (1 << last_bit);
            sum_prob[mask] = sum_prob[prev_mask] + probabilities[last_bit];
            for (int i = 0; i < valid_count; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    D[mask | (1 << i)] += D[mask] * probabilities[i] / (1.0 - sum_prob[mask]);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < size; mask++) {
            int count_bits = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            if (count_bits == max_k) {
                for (int i = 0; i < valid_count; i++) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        Q[i] += D[mask];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < total_numbers; i++) {
            if (index_map[i] == -1) {
                System.out.print("0 ");
            } else {
                System.out.print(Q[index_map[i]] + " ");
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
        sc.close();
    }
}
